2534: from καί and γέ; and at least (or even, indeed):--and, at least.

2555: from κακός and ποιέω; a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.
2556: apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas πονηρός properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious:--bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.
2557: from κακός and the base of ἔργον; a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.
2558: from a presumed compound of κακός and ἔχω; to maltreat:--which suffer adversity, torment.
2559: from κακός; to injure; figuratively, to exasperate:--make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.
2560: from κακός; badly (physically or morally):--amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

2567: from καλός and διδάσκαλος; a teacher of the right:--teacher of good things.

2569: from καλός and ποιέω; to do well, i.e. live virtuously:--well doing.

2578: apparently a primary verb; to bend:--bow.
2579: from καί and ἐάν; and (or even) if:--and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.

2594: from a derivative of κράτος (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient):--endure.
